item.title: Nvidia confirms “Spring” release for DLSS Dynamic Frame Generation
item.description: DLSS 4.5 Dynamic Frame Generation will be released in “Spring” At a recent event, an Nvidia representative reportedly stated that its DLSS Dynamic Frame Generation technology would be released in “April”. Since then, Nvidia has stated that this was a “misunderstanding”, reconfirming that DLSS Dynamic Frame Generation would be released this “Spring”.
